name: Birth Date
description: This is the structure defining date of birth and how it's been defined.

Concept.name: Date of Birth
Concept.description:
Date of Birth (DOB) is the official calendar date on which an individual was born, as recognised by the appropriate civil authority or as evidenced by legally accepted documentation.

It is a core identity anchor, used across legal, administrative, operational, and analytical systems, and is typically immutable once verified.

DOB is distinct from the Birth Registration Date (administrative) and the Birth Notification Date (clinical/operational).

It may be an estimate.

Attributes.name: Estimated DOB
Attributes.description: Estimated DOB is a data quality indicator used when precise dates of birth are unavailable for identification purposes. Per POLE Data Standards, estimated DOB must pass validation checks: must not be future dates, current dates, or ages exceeding 120 years

ConceptFrom.description: Birth covers data elements that record the circumstances of an individual’s birth. It includes factual, verifiable attributes such as date, place, and conditions of birth, along with any official registration details issued by an authority.
